'''2004 Georgia State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship played on Saturday 22 May 2004 at T & T Toys, 3750 Venture Drive NW, Duluth, Georgia (Atlanta area); [[John Anderson]] announced it on the PC forums. It was six games of Swiss followed by a two-game final confrontation between the top two; the winner received an uncut sheet and a bye into Day 2 of the [[2004 World Championship]]. Twelve players took part, and Dan Brown won.<ref name="pcf-3247">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040905212648/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=3247&amp GA States], John Anderson (2 and 23 May 2004), Player's Committee Forums, swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 5 September 2004.</ref> In April 2004 Anderson wrote that he expected the championship to be held at the GPN Weekend ATL on 21–23 May 2004;<ref name="pcf-2224-45358">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=45358#45358 Georgia Tourneys], John Anderson (Shadow 29), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (24 April 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040518230111/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=44893%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> on 6 May he listed it as an Open event at T & T Toys on 22 May, a week after an Open tournament at the same store on 15 May, with the schedule on [[DeckTech]].<ref name="pcf-2224-45970">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=45970#45970 Georgia Tourneys], John Anderson (Shadow 29), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (6 May 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040518230111/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=44893%26amp Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-3211-45907">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=45907#45907 Looking for players in GA, particularly Augusta and Atlanta], John Anderson (Shadow 29), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (4 May 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040627213856/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=3211%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' T & T Toys, Duluth, Georgia<ref name="pcf-3247" />
* '''Dates:''' 22 May 2004<ref name="pcf-3247" />
* '''Announced by:''' [[John Anderson]]<ref name="pcf-3247" />
* '''Players:''' 12<ref name="pcf-3247" />
* '''Winner:''' Dan Brown<ref name="pcf-3247" />

== Results ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Place !! Player !! Swiss record
|-
| 1st || Dan Brown || 5–1 (timed win against Paul Myers)
|-
| 2nd || [[Paul Myers]] || 5–1 (win against Dan Brown)
|-
| 3rd || [[Chris Simmons]] || 5–1 (two timed wins)
|}

Final confrontation: in game 1 Myers's Watch Your Step Raiders beat Brown's Bring Him Before Me by 28; in game 2 Brown's Profit beat Myers's Senate by 30, and Brown was declared State Champion. Three players came from out of town (two from Augusta and one from Florida).<ref name="pcf-3247" /> Several players were missing, including [[Damian Loback]], [[Stephen Morgan]], [[Sean Morrison]], [[James Boyd|Jim Boyd]] and the Tennessee players; Anderson estimated that with them the field would have been about 18.<ref name="pcf-3247-46641">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=46641#46641 GA States], John Anderson (Shadow 29), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (23 May 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040901021935/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=46766%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Anderson played and did not qualify for Day 2 of the World Championship.<ref name="pcf-3797-51876">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=51876#51876 Day 1], John Anderson (Shadow 29), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (2 August 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041105141844/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=52779%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> In September 2004 a player who had attended the Atlanta GPN weekend wrote that, three months later, he had received his foil from Decipher but no prizes from [[Game Players Network|GPN]].<ref name="pcf-2224-54403">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54403#54403 Georgia Tourneys], dough, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (23 September 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041031045257/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54786%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
